{{Otheruses|Spiner}}
'''Spiner plants''' were rare [[Flower/Legends|flowering]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] which could be found growing in moist, humid environments like those found in [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. Generally regarded as beautiful, the plant harbored a potentially lethal [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] that dulled the victim's senses and impeded its natural bodily processes. A spiner plant delivered this toxin by shooting envenoming thorns at creatures that brushed against it. Despite its danger, this toxin was also valuable, as it could be processed into a [[serum]] that could treat a variety of [[Disease/Legends|diseases]] and other poisons.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
